description: Classification of EL checklist items by distance-measurement applicability. Covers guides 1, 2, 13 (101 items).

categories.horizontal: Requires plan-view distance measurement — tool CAN measure
categories.vertical-or-mixed: Requires vertical/3D clearance — tool CANNOT fully measure (yet)

EL-1.1.deficiency: Buildings and permanent structures do not maintain minimum 7 feet 6 inches horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead electric conductors

EL-1.10.deficiency: Fence posts do not maintain minimum 10-foot horizontal clearance from overhead electric poles

EL-1.11.deficiency: Fences connecting to or near substation fences not electrically isolated with 10-foot non-conductive isolation panel connecting the two fences

EL-1.12.deficiency: Fencing near electric transmission lines not constructed of non-conductive material or not properly grounded, or specifications and grounding details not provided

EL-1.13.deficiency: Vehicle barrier fencing beneath overhead electric lines does not maintain minimum 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance from outermost electric line or lacks vertical and horizontal clearance verification exhibits

EL-1.14.deficiency: Retaining walls do not maintain minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from outermost electric line where overhead facilities are present

EL-1.15.deficiency: Retaining walls adjacent to Austin Energy substation walls do not maintain minimum 5-foot separation to allow for grounding grid extension, wall inspection, wall replacement, and proper drainage

EL-1.16.deficiency: Emergency access structures (bridges, elevated platforms) do not maintain minimum 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance and 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductor of overhead electric facilities

EL-1.17.deficiency: Retaining walls lack section exhibits showing dimensions from outer electric conductor to outermost edge of wall for clearance verification

EL-1.18.deficiency: Driveways do not maintain minimum 16-foot vertical clearance (parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot vertical clearance (areas with truck traffic) from lowest point of overhead electric facilities including telecommunications attachments

EL-1.19.deficiency: Vehicles parked or displayed on concrete pads do not maintain minimum vertical clearance from lowest overhead electric lines, or requirement not noted on site plans

EL-1.2.deficiency: Customer facilities do not maintain minimum 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductor of overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors

EL-1.20.deficiency: Final road and driveway grades do not maintain minimum 30-foot vertical clearance from electric transmission lines to ground surface

EL-1.21.deficiency: Final highway and freeway grades with distribution underbuilt do not maintain minimum 40-foot vertical clearance from overhead electric lines to road surface

EL-1.22.deficiency: Existing electric poles in conflict with proposed driveways not relocated minimum 30 feet from edge of driveway

EL-1.23.deficiency: Clearance dimensions measured from utility pole or centerline instead of from outside conductor or outermost electric line as required by code

EL-1.24.deficiency: Streetlight poles located under overhead electric lines

EL-1.25.deficiency: Sidewalks not cleared from existing power poles at each end of property along right-of-way

EL-1.26.deficiency: Enclosed trash areas and trash receptacles placed under overhead electric facilities creating risk of contact when trash bins are raised during service

EL-1.27.deficiency: Customer facilities proposed to be installed under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution facilities in violation of prohibition, or items within electric easements do not maintain minimum 7.5-foot clearance from outside conductor

EL-1.28.deficiency: Water meters do not maintain minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from outside conductor of existing overhead electric service drops

EL-1.29.deficiency: Water lines do not maintain minimum clearance from existing overhead electrical distribution facilities

EL-1.3.deficiency: Building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, decks, roofs, patios) do not maintain required clearances from overhead electric conductors

EL-1.30.deficiency: Permanent foundations within 5 feet of property line do not allow necessary clearance space for electric facilities

EL-1.31.deficiency: Survey by registered surveyor showing pole locations and mid-span clearances not provided when existing overhead facilities may not meet minimum vertical clearance requirements

EL-1.32.deficiency: Overhead electric line crossings of roadways not oriented at 90-degree angle to road

EL-1.33.deficiency: Secondary overhead electric lines cross over primary overhead electric lines

EL-1.34.deficiency: Marquee signs lack clearance verification or do not provide profile exhibits showing dimensions from sign to existing electrical poles including all conductors and neutral line

EL-1.35.deficiency: New power poles for underground service located less than 20 feet from existing power poles

EL-1.36.deficiency: Decorative lighting proposed under existing overhead electric lines does not meet clearance requirements or is not relocated

EL-1.37.deficiency: Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors or 50 lateral feet of overhead transmission conductors are not from Utility Compatible Shade Trees list, or site grading does not meet required clearances from transmission facilities

EL-1.38.deficiency: Proposed meter locations obstructed by site features, structures, or landscaping

EL-1.39.deficiency: Proposed development does not maintain required clearances from existing streetlights

EL-1.4.deficiency: Gas pump canopies do not maintain required clearances from overhead electric lines

EL-1.40.deficiency: Down guy wires conflicting with accessible paths, driveways, or other site features not resolved through pole relocation or conversion to self-supporting steel poles

EL-1.41.deficiency: Guy easements for down guy anchors not provided extending 10 feet either side of guy wire plus 50 feet beyond end of anchor

EL-1.42.deficiency: Down guy anchor points lack dedicated easement 10 feet wide extending 5 feet past where down guy enters ground

EL-1.43.deficiency: Transformers do not maintain minimum 7.5-foot vertical sky-to-ground clearance from overhead electric lines

EL-1.44.deficiency: Transformers and switchgears in niche service configurations do not maintain minimum 35-foot vertical clearance inside niche and niche entrance

EL-1.45.deficiency: Construction staging areas, equipment operation zones, and work platforms do not maintain minimum 10-foot radial clearance from energized overhead electric lines per OSHA and Texas law

EL-1.46.deficiency: Plans do not include required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines

EL-1.47.deficiency: Service-mast through-roof installations do not maintain minimum 3-foot clearance above roof, or 18-inch clearance if within 4 feet of roof edge, for voltages ≤300V

EL-1.5.deficiency: Stairs, elevated walkways, and elevated platforms do not maintain minimum 15-foot radial clearance from overhead electric distribution facilities

EL-1.6.deficiency: Buildings do not maintain minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance and 15-foot radial clearance from overhead electric facilities in right-of-way adjacent to site

EL-1.7.deficiency: Surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors not included on building elevation sheets to demonstrate required clearances are met

EL-1.8.deficiency: Section and plan view exhibits do not show dimensions from outer electric conductor to outermost edge of buildings and building projections for clearance verification

EL-1.9.deficiency: Fences do not maintain minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from outside conductor of overhead electric facilities

EL-13.1.deficiency: Transformer pads lack minimum 5-foot clearance from buildings, structures, and building foundations

EL-13.12.deficiency: Transformer pads lack minimum 5-foot clearance from fire hydrants

EL-13.13.deficiency: Trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted equipment are not identified as utility-compatible species per ECM Appendix F, or trees within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductors are not utility-compatible

EL-13.14.deficiency: Shrubs or low-lying vegetation lack minimum 10 lateral feet clearance from transformer access door side, or lack minimum 5 lateral feet clearance from other sides (non-access door)

EL-13.15.deficiency: Trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment lack required root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, installed 5 feet from equipment)

EL-13.16.deficiency: Transformer pads lack minimum 5-foot clearance from dumpsters

EL-13.17.deficiency: Transformer pads lack minimum 5-foot clearance from bike racks

EL-13.18.deficiency: Transformer pads lack minimum 5-foot clearance from light poles

EL-13.19.deficiency: Transformer pads lack minimum 15-foot clearance from fire lanes

EL-13.2.deficiency: Transformer pads lack minimum 5-foot clearance from retaining walls

EL-13.20.deficiency: Transformer pads lack minimum 5-foot clearance from other transformer pads

EL-13.21.deficiency: Transformer pads lack minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from water lines

EL-13.22.deficiency: Transformer pads lack minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from wastewater lines

EL-13.23.deficiency: Transformer pads lack minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from storm drain lines

EL-13.24.deficiency: Transformer pads lack minimum horizontal clearance from gas lines (24 inches minimum for gas pipelines less than 60 psi, 36 inches minimum for high-pressure gas 60 psi and over)

EL-13.25.deficiency: Transformer pads lack minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearance from other underground utilities (except gas, fuel, steam)

EL-13.26.deficiency: Transformer pads or AE underground facilities located over or under other utility lines, or customer buildings/foundations/structures installed over AE underground facilities

EL-13.27.deficiency: Transformer locations lack minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead distribution line conductors (primary, neutral, and secondary), extending from ground to sky

EL-13.28.deficiency: Transformer locations or proposed facilities lack minimum 15-foot radius clearance from overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors (measured from conductors, not pole centerline)

EL-13.29.deficiency: Transformer locations in enclosed or notched-out areas (niches) lack minimum 35-foot vertical clearance inside niche and niche entrance, or lack cross-section drawings demonstrating clearance

EL-13.3.deficiency: Transformer pads lack required clearance from fences and gates - 5 feet for sides with operators/controls, 3 feet for sides without operators/controls (from removable ventilated fences)

EL-13.30.deficiency: Niche service installations lack required 3-hour fire wall rating for walls and ceilings, proper ventilation specifications, or documentation of consultation with Austin Energy Design business unit

EL-13.31.deficiency: Cross-section drawings not provided showing vertical clearances in access paths with overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas

EL-13.32.deficiency: Grading plan shows drainage slopes toward building from oil-filled transformer pad location (liquid flow must be away from building)

EL-13.33.deficiency: Transformer pads not located 100% on private property, located in public right-of-way, or straddling property lines

EL-13.34.deficiency: Transformer pads located in prohibited easements including drainage easements, water easements, sewer easements, or electrical easements under overhead lines without Austin Energy Design written approval

EL-13.35.deficiency: Transformer easements not shown around pads, or easement width inadequate for Austin Energy accessibility requirements

EL-13.36.deficiency: Electrical routing from transformer to meter not 100% on private property

EL-13.37.deficiency: Transformer pad dimensions do not match Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets for specified service type (single-phase or three-phase)

EL-13.38.deficiency: Equipment pad installed within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle routes lacks required 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts (bollards) per AE Design equipment pad details, or bollards not spaced to allow equipment door opening

EL-13.39.deficiency: Customer facilities (buildings, parking garages, light poles, signs, billboards, chimneys, antennas, tanks) installed under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution facilities

EL-13.4.deficiency: Transformer pads with reduced clearances (3 feet to brick/masonry buildings) lack documentation of Austin Energy Design written approval or do not meet required conditions (not in confined space, 10 ft+ to windows/doors/ducts, 15 ft+ vertical clearance to windows/doors/ducts, 3-hour fire rating)

EL-13.5.deficiency: Transformer pads lack minimum 5-foot lateral clearance from balconies and building overhangs, or have coverings/structures directly above pad or minimum equipment area

EL-13.6.deficiency: Transformer pads lack minimum 12-foot horizontal clearance from windows, doors, or ventilating ducts when window/door/duct is less than 12 feet from grade or has less than 5 feet lateral separation (oil-filled equipment)

EL-13.7.deficiency: Transformer pads not located minimum 2 feet from back of sidewalks

EL-13.8.deficiency: Transformer pads lack required clearance from stairwells serving as fire exits
EL-13.8.threshold: unspecified but clearance-based (related to 20-foot fire escape requirement)

EL-13.9.deficiency: Transformer pads lack minimum 20-foot horizontal/radial clearance from fire escapes or stairs serving as fire escapes (oil-filled equipment)

EL-2.1.deficiency: Non-utility-compatible trees proposed within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductor or equipment

EL-2.10.deficiency: Plant legend or plant schedule does not identify species of trees proposed near electric facilities

EL-2.11.deficiency: Large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) not differentiated on plans to allow verification of clearances from overhead electric facilities

EL-2.12.deficiency: Tree clearances measured from utility pole centerline or structure instead of from outer electric conductor

EL-2.13.deficiency: Tree clearances measured from tree canopy instead of from tree trunk (planting location)

EL-2.14.deficiency: Trees not shown on landscape plan in relation to overhead electric facilities, preventing clearance verification

EL-2.15.deficiency: Plans propose trees within prohibited clearance zones without documented Austin Energy written approval

EL-2.2.deficiency: Non-utility-compatible trees proposed within 50 lateral feet of overhead electric transmission conductor or equipment

EL-2.3.deficiency: Large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) proposed within 25 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductor or equipment

EL-2.4.deficiency: Large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) proposed within 50 lateral feet of overhead electric transmission conductor or equipment

EL-2.5.deficiency: Trees (any species) proposed within transmission easement boundaries

EL-2.6.deficiency: Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead electric utility pole

EL-2.7.deficiency: Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted electric equipment, or between equipment access door and drivable surface

EL-2.8.deficiency: Trees proposed within 5 lateral feet of underground electric equipment

EL-2.9.deficiency: Trees proposed within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment lack required root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment)

subClassifications.distance-only: Distance measurement alone can resolve the verdict (compare measured value to threshold)
subClassifications.distance-plus: Distance measurement needed but verdict also requires additional information (see additionalRequirements)

additionalRequirementTypes.species-verification: Tree species must be confirmed as utility-compatible or non-compatible per ECM Appendix F
additionalRequirementTypes.material-specification: Construction material type must be verified (non-conductive, fire-rated, etc.)
additionalRequirementTypes.orientation-identification: Equipment access door orientation must be identified on plans
additionalRequirementTypes.equipment-type-identification: Equipment type (oil-filled vs dry-type) must be determined
additionalRequirementTypes.documentation-approval: Written approval from Austin Energy Design is required
additionalRequirementTypes.root-barrier-specification: Root barrier details must be specified (depth, position from equipment)
additionalRequirementTypes.bollard-specification: Bollard details must be specified (diameter, spacing, material)

shouldCall.description: Binary should-call grade for measure-distance: yes if the agent should reach for the tool on this item, no otherwise. Used for rigorous per-(item × run) recall and misuse rates.
